request.summary: Reduce beginner ontology teaching into the smallest reusable explanation unit.
request.intent: Choose enough explanation variety for nodes and lanes without turning the visualization into a wall of text.

outputs: one explanation-card contract with six selectable lenses
validation: abstraction-level guard selected an artifact-level explanation card
recomposition proof covered all nodes and lanes through one shared lens contract
evolution profile preserved a data-level extension boundary for future modes
cognitive-load check selected one visible lens at a time
requisite-variety check retained plain, state, process, example, analogy, and boundary
boundary-object check kept beginner language separate from technical and authority ownership
concept-versus-knowledge check classified copy as interpretive candidate text
premortem paired analogies with explicit boundaries and completeness tests
navigation check placed the guide before the graph
execution.notes: Standard mode used one proposal track and two bounded reductions. Proposer selected six explanation lenses. Balancer objected to simultaneous density and analogy overreach. Reconciliation used a global one-lens selector, technical details below beginner copy, and explicit boundary text.
